description_en: Queries the details of a single ServiceTask under a specified application
description_zh: 查询指定应用下单个 ServiceTask 的详情
kebab_example: aliyun cms get-service-task --workspace default-cms-1672753017899339-cn-hangzhou --service-id ggxw4lnjuz@f2fd3a6265a254a052afb --api-version 2024-03-30 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetServiceTask

parameters.help_zh: 工作空间名称。例如 default-cms-<uid>-<region>
parameters.name: workspace

parameters.help_en:
The task type. This parameter is required. Valid values:

heapdump: heap dump.
LiveDebug Probe: live_debug_log_probe, live_debug_snapshot_probe, live_debug_metric_probe, live_debug_span_probe, live_debug_span_tag_probe.
LiveDebug Command: live_debug_inspect_object, live_debug_search_type, live_debug_search_method, live_debug_decompile, live_debug_get_thread_info, live_debug_get_runtime_info, live_debug_get_memory_info, live_debug_evaluate_expression, live_debug_modify_logger_level.
LiveDebug code hot replacement: live_debug_code_replace.

The value must be the same as the type specified during task creation
parameters.help_zh: 任务类型，必填。支持：heapdump（堆转储）；LiveDebug Probe：live_debug_log_probe、live_debug_snapshot_probe、live_debug_metric_probe、live_debug_span_probe、live_debug_span_tag_probe；LiveDebug Command：live_debug_inspect_object、live_debug_search_type、live_debug_search_method、live_debug_decompile、live_debug_get_thread_info、live_debug_get_runtime_info、live_debug_get_memory_info、live_debug_evaluate_expression、live_debug_modify_logger_level；LiveDebug 代码热替换：live_debug_code_replace。必须与创建时的 type 一致
parameters.name: type

serviceTask.description_en: The task details object. Common fields include taskId, serviceId, workspace, regionId, ip, taskType, extraInfo (taskConfig JSON for LiveDebug), createTime, and updateTime
serviceTask.description_zh: 任务详情对象。常见字段包含 taskId、serviceId、workspace、regionId、ip、taskType、extraInfo（LiveDebug 时为 taskConfig JSON）、createTime、updateTime 等
